title: Dark Savior
subtitle: A prisoner on the loose
summary: Dark Savior is Climax Entertainment's adventure, first released for Saturn in Japan on 30 August 1996.
body: Dark Savior is Climax Entertainment's adventure, first released for Saturn in Japan on 30 August 1996. Bounty hunter Garian is escorting the dangerous creature Bilan to a prison island when it escapes aboard the ship. His pursuit begins a story whose direction depends on how quickly he reaches the captain's cabin. Exploration uses an angled three-dimensional view, with platforming and puzzles between conversations. Fights then move into a separate side-view system. These changes make the journey a sequence of different tasks, connected by Garian's investigation and the consequences of his opening pursuit.

Exploring the island requires judging jumps and finding a useful view around obstacles. The camera can be adjusted to reveal routes hidden by the scenery, while combat confines the characters to a two-dimensional plane despite its three-dimensional presentation. Certain defeated opponents can be captured and used in later fights, adding another reason to learn their abilities. Items found during exploration can also be traded for information, other objects or points. Those points support practical choices, including improving Garian's health or helping him recover from a defeat.

The time taken during the shipboard opening determines which parallel story follows. Returning to the beginning can therefore lead into another version of the adventure, where events and encounters develop differently. That structure makes an action performed before the player fully understands its importance into the hinge of the whole journey. Climax had previously made Landstalker, and the angled exploration recalls that experience, but Dark Savior adds its own divided narrative and separate fighting system. The result asks the player to learn both the island's spaces and the possibilities concealed in an earlier arrival.
story_headings: Changing the rules of an encounter
